overview: This table defines the stamps players can send in lobby and battle chat, with each stamp's picture, words, and voice line.
description: Defines the fixed chat stamps (stickers) available in lobby and battle chat, including their sprite, caption, and character voice line.

Id.simple: The name that links this stamp to the chat message players send and receive.
Id.technical: FName; the export's ImportKeyField is Id and all 31 rows use the same STAMP_0xx string as row key and ID. Selecting a stamp puts this value in FGameOnlineSendMessage::ID with Type=EGameOnlineSendMessageType::Stamp; after online filtering/broadcast, UGameChatMessageWidget copies it to FPendingRequest::RowName and FindRow<FGameDataTableRow_Stamp> scans StampDataTables in array order, stopping at the first match (no row means no stamp display). The value is not read to choose the sprite, caption, or voice; those come from other fields of the matched row.

FileName.simple: The name of the picture players see on the stamp in chat. Change it to show a different image.
FileName.technical: FName used as a WidgetSprite primary-asset name. Stamp list items pass it to FindDynamicLoadSprite (a DynamicLoadSpriteMap lookup, not an on-demand load) and set the result on the stamp image; incoming stamps copy it into FGameStampMessageRequest::FileName, and ShowStampMessage repeats the cache lookup. Visual-lobby, PvE-interval, and WidgetTest setup create GamePrimaryAssetType_WidgetSprite loaders from every row's FileName and later insert the loaded sprites under the same key; a missing prefetch leaves a null brush.

Id_StampText.simple: The name that picks the words shown on the stamp button and in chat for the player's language.
Id_StampText.technical: FName key, not the localized string itself. List items call SetButtonTextId(Id_StampText, EApplicationLanguage::Invalid); Invalid makes SetButtonTextId use SetTextIdOnly/current language. Incoming stamps copy the key into FGameStampMessageRequest::TextId, and ShowStampMessage also calls SetTextIdOnly, which resolves non-SYS IDs through AGameTextManager's shared GameText tables. StampTextDataTable_<Language> is one of those tables; every exported stamp ID has a row in all 11 exported locales. A missing ID resolves to an empty string; no shipped row is empty.

Id_Voice.simple: The name that picks the voice line heard when this stamp arrives in chat.
Id_Voice.technical: FName key into VoiceDataTables. UGameChatMessageWidget::ShowRequest (not ShowStampMessage itself) calls AGameSoundManager::PlayVoiceById(Id_Voice, sender index) after a stamp row is found; it resolves the Voice row to CueSheetName/CueName and plays it on the sender's slot, returning -1 when no Voice row exists. The local send-selection path does not play this voice. All 31 exported IDs are VoCha_* values present in VoiceDataTable, with CP_* prefixes matching their caption IDs; that is an export naming pattern, not a runtime check of the sender's character.

notes: The supplied export has exactly one StampDataTable shard with 31 rows (STAMP_001-STAMP_031). Each Id equals its row key, and Id, FileName, Id_StampText, and Id_Voice are all populated and unique within the export. There are no numeric fields, units, or coded sentinel values in the row; the empty native constructor leaves FName members as NAME_None only for rows that omit them.

FGameDataTableArray can hold multiple UDataTable pointers and incoming lookup scans them in array order, breaking at the first matching row, but AGameDataTableManager::StartInitialLoading requests only the primary asset named StampDataTable and AddLoadedDataTables skips nulls. The reconstructed retail load path therefore has at most one stamp table; no numbered StampDataTable shards were supplied or referenced.

InitializeWidget builds the stamp list from every row (table order, then row-name order) with no character or chat-category filter, and SetupChatList passes that same list to the chat window. The row has no ownership, unlock, progress, or array-index field.

Indirect dependencies are locale-specific StampTextDataTable_<Language> for Id_StampText, WidgetSprite primary assets cached in DynamicLoadSpriteMap for FileName, and VoiceDataTable for Id_Voice. Missing text, sprite, or voice data yields an empty string, null brush, or -1 respectively rather than a fallback row.
No retail Blueprint/editor-tool source or full Content tree was available. C++ conclusions come from the reconstructed static source and the supplied exports, not a runtime retail capture.

usages.detail: Resolves the single StampDataTable primary asset into StampDataTables after all loaders complete; StartInitialLoading registers only that name (:435).
Rebuilds all stamp item data from every row in InitializeWidget; SetupChatList passes the unfiltered list to the chat window (:221).
On selection sends the row's Id as an FGameOnlineSendMessage with Type=Stamp, arms the shared fixed-phrase cooldown, and closes the chat window.
Sends the Stamp message to the local user and unmuted users when online communication is enabled; the receive path filters blocked/muted senders before broadcasting to widgets (:1441).
Queues Chat/Stamp messages only while the chat message widget is open; Message.ID becomes the pending row name (:132).
Displays each stamp's localized caption and cached sprite on its list button, clearing the brush when released (:25).
Resolves the first StampDataTables row matching the incoming row name, copies text/sprite IDs, plays the voice by sender slot, and shows a pooled stamp content widget.
ShowStampMessage applies the localized text, sender name, and cached sprite to the stamp content.
Creates GamePrimaryAssetType_WidgetSprite loaders from all stamp FileNames, then caches the loaded sprites in the widget manager's DynamicLoadSpriteMap (:1584, :1621).
Adds all stamp FileNames to the PvE-interval WidgetSprite prefetch and caches the loaded sprites (:385, :450).
The test phase also prefetches every stamp sprite through WidgetSprite loaders and the sprite cache (:122, :154).
Loads locale-specific StampTextDataTable_<Language> into the shared GameText tables used by SetTextIdOnly.
PlayVoiceById resolves Id_Voice through VoiceDataTables and plays CueSheetName/CueName on the supplied slot, returning -1 for a missing row.
